purpose: English-detector patterns for the twelve-dimension Track B frame. Patterns were reassigned from the seven-dimension release by named rule (tools/migrate_rules_to_v3.py); one surface string may be evidence on several dimensions, because the dimensions ask different questions.

matching_conventions.normalisation: collapse all runs of whitespace to one space; keep original offsets in a separate map so locators stay exact
matching_conventions.word_boundary: every pattern is anchored with \b at both ends
matching_conventions.ambiguity_marker: rules whose hits need a human to choose between dimension values carry `disambiguation_needed` and are never auto-scored
matching_conventions.coverage_state: `instrumented` | `partially_instrumented` | `not_yet_instrumented` — a value is only eligible for the `not_attested_in_available_sources` state if it is `instrumented` AND every lexicon entry in the source languages associated with the work was searched

speech_act_markers.note: D7 is not detected by a term; it is detected by the shape of the window around the term. These markers run first and their output constrains which values the other dimensions may take. This ordering is deliberate: v1 read the term and inferred the doctrine, which is how a conditional became an atheist confession and Paul's 'one spirit' became monotheism.

conditional_hypothetical.constrains: D7=conditional_hypothetical; the contained negation is NOT an asserted doctrine

reported_speech.constrains: D7=reported_speech_of_opponent when the subject is human or an opponent

question.constrains: D7=doubt_or_inquiry; a question about divinity is not a denial of it

non_divine_speaker.constrains: D7=boast_of_non_divine_claimant when a first-person oneness formula follows

D1_ontological_category.question: What kind of thing is divinity taken to be, in this proposition?
D1_ontological_category.note: Set-valued. A text can hold that the ultimate is a personal being AND the ground in which other beings subsist; forcing one label invented a contradiction the tradition did not assert.

personal_being.definition: a being with mind, will and address, capable of being spoken to

impersonal_order_or_law.definition: an order, law, ground or absolute that is not a being and has no mental states

animating_substance_or_power.definition: sacred power as a quantifiable stuff or property that things may contain

collective_or_class.definition: 'the divine' names a class of beings; no single member is the referent

manifestation_or_hypostasis.definition: a visible face of a hidden depth; the addressed figure is not the whole

deified_mortal.definition: divinity as an honour a formerly human person received

unknowable_or_conceptless.definition: the ultimate is declared beyond the reach of these predicates

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D2a_acknowledged_population.question: How many divine beings does this proposition acknowledge?
D2a_acknowledged_population.note: A counting question only. It carries no claim about worship and none about the reality of the beings counted; both were split out of the old D2.

one_only.definition: exactly one divine being is acknowledged in the proposition

two_polar.definition: two complementary terms, neither reducible to the other

few_or_several.definition: a small definite number, without ranking

many_graded.definition: a plurality with ranks, offices, genealogy or a head

uncountable_or_numeric_scheme.definition: plurality expressed as a doctrinal number or as myriads

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D2b_reality_of_others.question: What status do other divine beings have, relative to the one in question?
D2b_reality_of_others.note: The truth-claim about rivals, separated from the counting question and from the worship question. A proposition can acknowledge many beings (D2a) while denying they are real, or acknowledge one while treating the others as real and subordinate.

others_denied_unreal.definition: other claimed divinities are explicitly not beings: nothing, non-beings, nameless, or the work of human hands

others_real_but_subordinate.definition: others exist and are ordered below the one in question

others_real_and_not_subordinate.definition: others exist and are not ranked under it

others_not_addressed.definition: the proposition is silent about any other being

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D2c_worship_exclusivity.question: Is devotion or rite restricted to this divinity?
D2c_worship_exclusivity.note: A normative question. 'Thou shalt have no other gods before me' is evidence here, not in D2b: it commands a practice and says nothing about whether other beings exist. The v1 audit found three worship prohibitions counted as existence claims; this dimension exists so the frame cannot make that mistake again.

exclusive_devotion_commanded.definition: rite, prayer or allegiance is owed to this divinity alone

inheritance_filter.reason: D2c asks whether devotion is restricted; an existence formula says nothing about practice and may not be scored as a worship claim

devotion_to_others_permitted.definition: the text treats devotion to other beings as legitimate, including when it is describing a practice it disapproves of in another voice

devotion_mediated_by_hierarchy.definition: access runs through subordinate beings, angels, saints or offices

no_devotional_language.definition: the proposition makes no claim about practice at all

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D3_agency.question: What agency is predicated — personhood, will, manner of acting, delegation?
D3_agency.note: Set-valued. Deliberating will, delegated execution and reciprocal dependency coexist in ordinary religious texts; the old single label made them compete.

personalhood_mind_and_will.definition: the divine is spoken of as having mind, will and the capacity to be addressed

effortless_self_evolution.definition: produces without deliberation or labour: emanation, self-differentiation

law_without_will.definition: cosmos runs by an impersonal regularity that is itself sacred

delegated_execution.definition: authorship is nominal; subordinates, angels, fate-figures or offices do the work

reciprocal_dependency.definition: the divine needs human rite, sacrifice or prayer to remain effective

non_agential.definition: the divine is contemplative, immobile, does nothing

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D4_cosmic_function.question: What work is the divinity credited with?
D4_cosmic_function.note: Set-valued, unchanged from the previous release; the values and their detectors are inherited verbatim.

creating_ex_nihilo_or_by_word.definition: bringing world into being, often by utterance or command

generating_by_procreation.definition: world and gods issued by begetting, birth or union

dissolving_or_reabsorbing.definition: ending or drawing the world back into itself

revealing_teaching_lawgiving.definition: communicating knowledge or statute to humans

rescuing_healing_restoring.definition: soteriological action toward humans in a damaged condition

fertilisingWeather_agricultural.definition: storm, dew, grain, fertility: the divine as livelihood guarantee

guarding_localised.definition: defence of a place, people, house or cult site

no_function_attributed.definition: invoked but credited with no cosmic or human work

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D5_universe_relationship.question: What is the relation between divinity and the world?
D5_universe_relationship.note: Set-valued, and the composite value 'other_and_indwelling' is gone: transcendence and immanence are two labels that may both apply, which is what the texts actually say.

wholly_other.definition: the divine and the world are distinct kinds; the world does not contain or constitute it

indwelling_in_world.definition: the divine is present within the world or within its worshipers

identical_with_world.definition: the cosmos itself, or its totality, is the divine

world_in_divine_not_exhausting.definition: the world is within the divine but does not exhaust it

retreated_or_absent.definition: a deity made the world and withdrew, was displaced, or is inaccessible

world_as_appearance.definition: the cosmos is unreal, degraded or illusory relative to the divine

scale_not_claimed.definition: the divine is bound to places, animals, lineage or cult; no cosmic-scale claim

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D6_temporal_nature.question: What is the divinity's relation to time, to beginning and to end?
D6_temporal_nature.note: Set-valued. Eternal existence, cyclic recurrence and an eschatological function are three properties, not three mutually exclusive answers to one question.

uncreated_eternal.definition: no beginning; exists necessarily or from ever

born_in_time.definition: has a genealogy, a birth, a youngest generation

cyclically_recurrent.definition: divine acts or ages return on a measurable cycle

linear_once.definition: one creation and one consummation; history does not repeat

eschatologically_future.definition: the decisive divine reality is still to arrive

from_lost_past.definition: the divine walked with humans and has departed

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D7a_speaker_attribution.question: Who is the utterer this text prints in this proposition?
D7a_speaker_attribution.note: Attribution only. The previous release mixed the speaker with the act, the genre and the text's stance.
D7a_speaker_attribution.assigned_by: clause and window shape (speech_act_markers), evaluated before the term dimensions

divine_self_speech.definition: the divine speaks in the first person within the proposition

narrator_or_scribe.definition: the framing voice of the text reports

character_within_narrative.definition: a figure in the story speaks; the text is not speaking

opponent_or_denier.definition: a claimant the text sets itself against speaks

editorial_or_ethnographic_frame.definition: a compiler, collector or missionary reports what others hold

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D7b_speech_act.question: What act is performed in this proposition?
D7b_speech_act.note: The illocutionary question, alone: asserting, addressing, commanding, questioning, conditioning, reporting, denying, boasting, or negating apophatically.
D7b_speech_act.assigned_by: clause and window shape (speech_act_markers), evaluated before the term dimensions

address_or_praise.definition: spoken to the divine rather than about it

command.definition: statute or prohibition; its force is 'you shall'

question.definition: interrogative; it seeks rather than concludes

report.definition: someone's words or a narrative event are relayed

deny.definition: a negation is performed as the act

boast.definition: a claimant exalts themselves; the text may or may not agree

negate_apophatically.definition: denial performed as worship: no attribute reaches it

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D7c_discourse_genre.question: What kind of discourse carries this proposition?
D7c_discourse_genre.note: Genre is not a speech act: a hymn contains address and doctrine, a prophetic oracle contains command and assertion, a commentary contains report and argument.
D7c_discourse_genre.assigned_by: clause and window shape (speech_act_markers), evaluated before the term dimensions

confessional_formula.definition: a fixed creed or shorthand of belief

prophetic_oracle.definition: declared as message, often with a messenger formula

commentary_or_description.definition: an outsider or editor describing a belief

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

D7d_epistemic_commitment.question: Does the framing text commit to the proposition, attribute it, reject it, or hold it open?
D7d_epistemic_commitment.note: Commitment is neither speaker nor act. An opponent may assert; a narrator may report; whether the text means the proposition to be so is answered by the frame around the clause. This is the question the previous release silently merged into speech act, and the reason a conditional could be read as an atheist confession.
D7d_epistemic_commitment.assigned_by: clause and window shape (speech_act_markers), evaluated before the term dimensions

endorsed_by_text.definition: the framing voice presents the proposition as so

attributed_not_endorsed.definition: the text relays the proposition without committing to it

rejected_in_text.definition: the framing voice sets the proposition against what it holds to be true

suspended_or_held_open.definition: question or condition: the text leaves it open

not_applicable_non_assertive.definition: the proposition is address, praise or command, so 'does the text assert it' has no application

undecidable.definition: the proposition does not commit; a reader could not say which value it carries

self_declaration: This rule set is an analyst-authored candidate generator. Every value's `coverage_state` is published so that a missing value cannot be mistaken for a missing concept. `not_yet_instrumented` is not `absent`: the instrument reports three states and the third is the honest majority.
distinctness_note: Set-valued dimensions (D1, D3, D4, D5, D6) may carry several values for one proposition. Single-valued dimensions (D2a, D2b, D2c, D7a, D7b, D7c, D7d) may not: when two of their values fire on one proposition the instrument records a conflict and asks a reader, instead of choosing by precedence.
distinctness_status: The dimensions are analytically distinct -- separately definable, separately answered -- which is weaker than orthogonal. Orthogonality is an empirical claim about observations and would require coded data to estimate; the detector patterns themselves correlate, since one English surface string can populate D2a, D2b and D2c together. See `config/divinity_ontology.json` key `distinctness_status`.

migration_from_seven_dimensions.old_D7_human_interpretation: Not inherited as a dimension. Its twelve labels distributed across four questions: asserted_doctrine -> D7b=assert plus D7d=endorsed_by_text; doxology_or_address -> D7b=address_or_praise plus D7c=hymn_or_prayer; mythic_narration -> D7b=report plus D7c=mythic_narrative; philosophical_argument -> D7c=philosophical_argument; prescriptive_command -> D7b=command plus D7c=legal_statute; conditional_hypothetical -> D7b=condition plus D7d=suspended_or_held_open; reported_speech_of_opponent -> D7a=opponent_or_denier plus D7b=report; polemic_denial -> D7b=deny; editorial_or_ethnographic_description -> D7a=editorial_or_ethnographic_frame plus D7d=attributed_not_endorsed; boast_of_non_divine_claimant -> D7b=boast plus D7d=rejected_in_text; apophatic_negation -> D7b=negate_apophatically; doubt_or_inquiry -> D7b=question plus D7c=doubt_or_inquiry. The old labels were not a mutually exclusive classification, which is why a hymn containing doctrine and a conditional containing a reported statement each had to be forced into one slot.
migration_from_seven_dimensions.old_D2_plurality: Split three ways. Every pattern in the old value set is now attached to the dimension whose question it actually answers; the sole_existent and sole_worshipable sets appear in all three D2 dimensions because those strings do carry all three claims, and the frame now records that separately instead of choosing one.
